name: receipt-system
status: draft, pending the confirmation round in the arena (System tab)
units: dots (1 dot = 1/203 inch on the TM-T88V at 512 dots wide)

pitch.note: A logical pixel is 3 dots. Each ink pixel is a 2x2 dot square with a 1-dot gap. This is the dot style of the winning 5x7 dot matrix in the font arena.

display_numerals.source: No arena test. Size chosen as moderate: big and huge numerals lost in the lab (taste profile).

headline.source: Pair duels used this headline size against all top body fonts. The 5x7 headline won 7 of 8 pair duels in pass 2.

body.source: Font pass 1: Dot matrix 5x7 B (cap 21) was the top font, 7-0 at the top of the leaderboard. Pair pass: 5x7 body won 7-1 against the other top bodies.

body_alt.use: Dense or long text only, when 5x7 at cap 21 does not fit. Not used in headlines or numerals.
body_alt.source: Sizes pass: Inter won at cap 20, and Inter B was third in font pass 1. The other secondary bodies were DM Sans, JetBrains Mono and IBM Plex Mono.

caption.source: 14 dots is the minimum text height in the brief.

label.source: Same as body. Labels sit on the same row as their value.

sizes_avoid.source: Sizes pass: 24 and above lost. Cap 16 was mid-ranked. Cap 18, 20 and 22 won.

fonts_avoid.source: Sizes pass losers. Font B and the bold weight also lost in the lab.

stroke.dot_line: 1 logical pixel (2-dot squares on the 3-dot pitch). Used for every outline and ornament.
stroke.rule_solid: 2 dots tall, solid, full content width.
stroke.heavy: not used. Heavy frames lost in the lab.

radius.note: Card corners use the medium radius (12 dots). The radius is a multiple of the 3-dot unit.

card.source: Templates pass: outlined 84%, outline 78%. Light weight 63% against bold 38%. No filled or elevated cards: they lost in the lab.

header.composition: caption, then headline, then the display number
header.source: Hello or no header won. Centred, wordmark, band, boxed and rules headers lost in the lab.

slots.divider: under the caption, full content width
slots.strip: under the caption, replaces the solid rule
slots.icon: top right corner of the card, 39 dots
slots.stamp: top right corner of the card, 72 dots
slots.corner: four corners inside the card inset

decoration.source: Templates pass: bands, rules, boxed, dots, stars and footer decorations lost. The arena's confirmation round tests the ornament family, not the stacking limit.

colour.tones: none. The output is 1-bit, and filled or tonal areas lost in the lab.
